integrity: Analytical proof of all quantifiers and an independent exact-rational finite sanity checker included. No claims of computer certification or independent review.
scientific_limitations: Only endpoint positivity of autonomous finite-state Markov chains for one fixed SSPRK(3,3) stage matrix and first/second-order weight constraints; intermediate stages and coarse-step accuracy are not controlled. The 2021 printed journal version is secondary to the publicly dated 2020 preprint.
title: A sharp three-state feasibility barrier for second-order adaptive SSPRK(3,3) weights
